Close Lichtlaerm Audio Medusa Swedish Death Machine Sale Regular price $229.00 Default Title - $229.00 USD Quantity Add to Cart The Medusa is the successor of the probably most infamous pedal created during Lichtlaerms first life: the Breathe//Die. As a collaboration with local Berlin band “Breathe//Die” it was the first HM2-style pedal to feature a noise reduction circuit, boost and an extended feature set in a compact enclosure. These sold out within days and subsequently went on the used market for an absurd amount As it’s been one of the most requested pedals to bring back to life Lichtlaerm decided to not just re-launch, but redesign the circuit to give you even more flexibility and the most cohesive package on the market! They took the first design and moved the boost into the core circuit resulting in up to three times the gain the classic chainsaw pedal offers you while also allowing you in to use the well-known cut control to shape the low end and create punchy palm mutes that the original was never capable of. Also increased the output immensely because… well: why not? With great power comes great responsibility: meaning with all the gain and high output volume you can’t avoid a certain level of noise. That’s why they added a full version of the Key Gate into the circuit : being triggered from the input like you’d do with modern noise gates and placed behind the loop so anything you blend with the Medusa profits from the gate as well.
